+def _rule_domain(rule: Rule) -> str:
+    """Return the full domain (subdomain plus server name) that a URL
+    rule is bound to, if any. Used to show which domain each route in
+    ``flask routes`` is registered under when an app uses subdomains.
+    """
+    server_name = current_app.config.get("SERVER_NAME") or ""
+
+    if rule.subdomain:
+        if server_name:
+            return f"{rule.subdomain}.{server_name}"
+
+        return rule.subdomain
+
+    return server_name
